analyst_view.overall: Early view: Cambuur have been strong at home (4-0 against Go Ahead before that game was abandoned, a win over PEC) and Johan Plat was October's Coach of the Month, but they lost 5-2 to PSV and, by one report, captain Amofa is out for the season. Sparta lost 3-1 at ADO, went out of the cup and may have a goalkeeper issue after Brouwer's ankle injury.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.1 goals. I lean lower: that is a big figure for 10th against 12th, Sparta scored only once at ADO, and Cambuur are without their captain. Over two and a half still looks the more likely side.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners split almost evenly. Nothing in the news changes how either side plays, so I keep it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. I lean lower: it is not a derby or a relegation game, neither side has bans or discipline issues in the news, and 2.5 cards for Sparta away looks high for a mid-table team.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.7 shots. Cambuur's home attack and Sparta's habit of creating chances (they hit the post at ADO) fit the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. A possible reserve keeper for Sparta matters for goals more than shots, so I keep it.
